channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: Massive US air build-up across Europe and Middle East
item.description: A surge in US military air activity across Europe and the Middle East is underway alongside rising tensions with Iran, with open-source tracking showing increased tanker, transport, and support aircraft movements over recent days. The post Massive US air build-up across Europe and Middle East first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Hawk to receive upgraded cockpit software under new contract
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has awarded a contract worth up to GBP 2.5 million to Inzpire Ltd to upgrade mission support systems used on the RAF Hawk T1 aircraft. The post Hawk to receive upgraded cockpit software under new contract first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Seven arrested in UK during global people-smuggling crackdown
item.description: Seven people have been arrested in the United Kingdom as part of an international operation targeting people smuggling and human trafficking networks, led by INTERPOL and coordinated domestically by the National Crime Agency. The post Seven arrested in UK during global people-smuggling crackdown first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK to study Aster 30 integration for Mk41 missile launcher
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has awarded a contract to MBDA UK to examine the feasibility of integrating the Mk41 Vertical Launching System with the Aster 30 missile. The post UK to study Aster 30 integration for Mk41 missile launcher first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: U.S. Marines select Anduril Bolt-M for OPF-L fielding
item.description: The award follows a 13-month testing and evaluation period in which Anduril supplied more than 250 Bolt-M systems to the U.S. Marine Corps. The post U.S. Marines select Anduril Bolt-M for OPF-L fielding first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK warns of rising Russian, Chinese activity in High North
item.description: Ministers and senior military leaders have warned that rising Russian activity and growing Chinese interest in the Arctic and High North are driving renewed focus on UK and NATO security in the region. The post UK warns of rising Russian, Chinese activity in High North first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Norway selects Chunmoo rocket system in huge deal
item.description: Norway has signed a contract to acquire the Chunmoo Multiple Rocket Launcher System (MRLS) from South Korean firm Hanwha Aerospace. The post Norway selects Chunmoo rocket system in huge deal first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Fleet of NATO warships heads for Baltic Sea
item.description: A multinational NATO naval force has departed southern Spain to begin the maritime phase of Exercise STEADFAST DART 26, according to the alliance. The post Fleet of NATO warships heads for Baltic Sea first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Audit earns fraud risks damaging British defence capability
item.description: The NAO estimates that the potential exposure to fraud could reach up to GBP 1.5 billion per year, with the majority of risk arising from defence procurement activity. The post Audit earns fraud risks damaging British defence capability first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK rejects calls for second British nuclear weapon system
item.description: The government has rejected calls to explore a second sovereign method of delivering UK nuclear weapons, arguing that the existing submarine-based system remains the most credible option as nuclear risks increase. The post UK rejects calls for second British nuclear weapon system first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
